key.name: stop-mode
key.description: Action used when a machine is switched off: acpipowerbutton, savestate or poweroff.

key.name: refresh-interval
key.description: Seconds between virtual machine state refreshes.

key.name: show-running-count
key.description: Show the number of running machines next to the panel icon.

key.name: show-window-toggle
key.description: Show a mode button on each machine that switches between window and headless: the start mode stored in VirtualBox while it is off, attach or detach the window while it runs.

key.name: panel-box
key.description: Area of the top bar that holds the indicator: left, center or right.

key.name: panel-position
key.description: Order of the indicator within its area. Lower numbers go further left, so indicators with different numbers keep their order whichever loads first.
